title: Concierge banking services explained
summary: Explains the bank’s concierge banking services, including dedicated personal banker access and how the banker coordinates complex transfers, multi‑party disbursements, account optimization guidance, and documentation/high‑touch requests. Covers how to request a consultation via secure account messaging, ask for periodic check‑ins, flag urgent requests, and best practices like sharing timelines and confirming instructions in writing.
